description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea and passwordless authentication with Managed Identity.
tasks.reason: The application currently stores photos in Oracle BLOBs and uses plaintext Oracle datasource credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database, and the plan specifies Managed Identity authentication.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver and update datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle-specific repository SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including photo BLOB storage to bytea. Configure the datasource to use Managed Identity instead of plaintext credentials, and point datasource URLs in application configuration to the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint.
